shared_elements: incised or drawn linear motifs on a flat field
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, linear anthropomorphic or stick-like figures and, in B, a prominent ring/disc that could loosely echo the small round forms in A, but nothing more specific is shared. A is a horizontal painted band of scattered small stick figures and angular marks across a wall, while B is a single monumental frontal human figure whose body bears low-relief symmetrical motifs (paired rings, a ring on the chest, a belt-like band) — a wholly different compositional scheme and manner of depiction.
